lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information for Israel. The dataset represents approximately 770.4 thousand buildings with an average data age of 2 years and 5% of buildings updated within the last 6 months. Data is provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for exposure assessment applications.
